name: fx
tagline: Tiny Zig coding agent from Vercel Labs — CLI, scripts, or embed via libfx/Wasm

xSignals.text: Vercel Labs Open-Sources fx: A Zig Coding Agent Designed to Be Embedded https://www.infoq.com/news/2026/10/vercel-zig-fx-agent/ by Daniel Curtis

You want a coding agent inside a CI job or a sandbox, and the first step is installing a whole runtime, waiting on a heavy startup, and watching it take over the terminal. Then it ignores your shell aliases and PATH and fails on the first command.
